critical.issue: Aging bucket is always 'Current' (capitalized) even when invoice is 15+ days overdue. Root cause: server.py defines _aging_bucket TWICE — first at line 2456 (Phase 9J: signature (due_date, outstanding), returns lowercase 'current'/'1-30'/'31-60'/'60+'), then again at line 3930 (Receivable module: signature (due_date, today), returns capitalized 'Current'). Python's late binding means the call at line 2602 `_aging_bucket(d.get('due_date'), outstanding)` resolves to the LATER function, which treats the outstanding number as the 'today' date string, fails `date.fromisoformat(today)`, and returns 'Current' in the except branch. Verified: created a payment with due_date 15 days in the past + outstanding=600000 → API returns aging='Current' instead of '1-30'. Also breaks frontend badge coloring (AGING map in Suppliers.jsx uses lowercase keys {current, 1-30, 31-60, 60+}) so all badges render uncolored.

rca of the issue.bug: Supplier-payments aging bucket always returns 'Current' regardless of overdue days.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) POST /api/supplier-payments with due_date 15 days in the past, amount=1000000, paid=400000. 2) GET /api/supplier-payments. Observed: {outstanding:600000, status:'PARTIAL', aging:'Current'}. Expected: aging:'1-30'.
rca of the issue.root_cause: server.py defines two functions with the same name `_aging_bucket`: line 2456 (Phase 9J) has signature (due_date, outstanding) → lowercase buckets; line 3930 (receivable module) has signature (due_date: str, today: str) → 'Current'/'1-30'/'31-60'/'61-90'/'>90'. Python takes the last binding. When the supplier-payments GET handler at line 2602 calls `_aging_bucket(d.get('due_date'), outstanding)`, `outstanding` (a float) is passed as `today` and `date.fromisoformat(today)` raises TypeError → the except returns 'Current'.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Rename one of the functions to a unique name (recommended: rename Phase 9J's helper to `_sup_aging_bucket` and update the reference at line 2602). No other logic change needed. Also align the returned bucket keys with the frontend AGING map or vice versa.
